svg.aria-label: Utilization without intensity is vanity; MFU as fraction of the roofline ceiling; batch-1 decode at 0.34 percent is physics
svg.text: Utilization and MFU: read them together
SM utilization counts warps with work to do, not useful work done.
A kernel doing wasted strided reads can show 90% SM utilization while moving a tenth of the bytes it should.
the roofline version: fraction of the attainable ceiling.
Kernel A (FP32 vector add) hit ~8% of its ceiling: a memory-access-pattern suspect.
Kernel B (FP8 GEMM) hit ~60%: compute-bound and healthy.
Batch-1 decode reaches ~0.34% of an H100's BF16 peak. That is not a bug in your code:
it is the physics of reading 140 GB to produce one token.
Intensity tells you what the work is worth; utilization tells you the SM was awake. You need both.
